skill.name: firecrawl-crawl

skill.summary: Crawl website sections with Firecrawl and save scoped multi-page extraction results.
skill.author: firecrawl

content.value_statement: Teams need reliable content from many pages without manual copying. This skill guides Firecrawl crawls with scoped paths, limits, progress, and saved results.
actual_capabilities: Runs Firecrawl crawl commands through the Firecrawl CLI or npx wrapper.
Crawls a full site or one section by following links to a chosen depth.
Uses include and exclude path filters to control crawl scope.
Limits page count, crawl depth, delay, and concurrent workers.
Waits for completion, shows progress, or checks an existing crawl job.
Writes crawl results to an output file when requested.
limitations: Requires Firecrawl CLI or npx availability in the agent environment.
May require a configured Firecrawl account and available crawl credits.
Can crawl only pages the service can access and process.
Users must provide authorization for targets and choose safe crawl limits.

use_cases.title: Collect Documentation Sections
use_cases.description: Crawl an entire docs area before migration, search indexing, or content review.

use_cases.title: Audit Product Content
use_cases.description: Extract many related pages to compare coverage, broken sections, and stale content.

use_cases.title: Gather Public Research Pages
use_cases.description: Capture public pages from a defined site section for analysis and summarization.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Docs Crawl
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner crawl of one documentation section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Crawl this documentation section with Firecrawl: https://example.com/docs. Limit it to 50 pages, wait for completion, and save the results.

prompt_templates.title: Filtered Section Crawl
prompt_templates.scenario: Crawl selected paths while excluding irrelevant pages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Crawl https://example.com, include only /learn paths, exclude /archive paths, show progress, and summarize returned pages.

prompt_templates.title: Budget Controlled Crawl
prompt_templates.scenario: Use crawl limits before running a larger extraction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Firecrawl credit usage first, then crawl https://example.com/docs with max depth 2, limit 25, and a delay between requests.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Scoped Crawl
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine discovery, filters, concurrency, and saved output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map the site if needed, then crawl /docs with include and exclude paths, max concurrency 3, progress updates, and a saved output file.

output_examples.input: Crawl a public docs section and save the results.
output_examples.output: A concise status report with pages crawled, skipped paths, output file location, and crawl warnings.

output_examples.input: Check an async crawl job returned by Firecrawl.
output_examples.output: A job status summary with completion state, available results, and the next recommended polling step.

output_examples.input: Crawl only selected URL paths from a large site.
output_examples.output: A scoped crawl result that includes matching pages and excludes paths outside the requested section.

best_practices: Use include paths and page limits before broad crawls.
Check credit usage before large or repeated crawl jobs.
Set delays and concurrency limits for large or sensitive sites.
anti_patterns: Crawling entire domains when one section is enough.
Running crawls without permission from the site owner or terms.
Saving crawl results to unclear or shared file paths.

faq.question: Does this skill crawl a single page?
faq.answer: It is designed for many pages. Use a scrape workflow when you only need one page.

faq.question: Can it limit crawl scope?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports include paths, exclude paths, page limits, and maximum crawl depth.

faq.question: Can it show crawl progress?
faq.answer: Yes. Use wait and progress options when you need live status before results are saved.

faq.question: Does Firecrawl charge credits for crawls?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill notes that crawls consume credits per page and recommends checking usage first.

faq.question: Can it check an existing crawl job?
faq.answer: Yes. It can check the status of a running crawl by using the returned job ID.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
